_note: Phase 3.6-RD final decision artifact. Synthesizes Phase 3.1-RD through 3.5-RD frozen evidence only. No new evaluation was performed to produce this file. Do not edit to change a status after the fact -- if new evidence later warrants a status change, that belongs in a new, separately authorized phase, not an edit here.

H1_supervised_risk_signal_exists.original_phase3_finding: Candidate F beats no-signal 6/6 seeds, AUROC 0.6548 [0.6159,0.6938] on synthetic data.

alibaba_temporal.caveat: 43.4% Q4 base rate vs 20.1% train -- see H3

real_data_evidence.agentrx: NOT_EVALUABLE -- no negative class in either frozen sample (44 Magentic, 29 tau-Retail)

H1_supervised_risk_signal_exists.final_status: SUPPORTED (Alibaba, confirmatory-capable precision); PARTIALLY SUPPORTED / exploratory-only (AIOps); NOT EVALUABLE (AgentRx)
H1_supervised_risk_signal_exists.key_limitation: No calibrated-confidence baseline exists in the real-data track, so H1 here answers 'beats no-signal', a narrower question than the original's framing.

H2_mechanism_is_supervision_not_represen.original_phase3_finding: Phase 3.2C isolated supervised learning, not representation richness, as the operative mechanism.

alibaba_random.interpretation: representation choice makes little difference -- consistent with original

alibaba_temporal.interpretation: representation choice dominates under distribution shift -- a boundary condition the original never tested

H2_mechanism_is_supervision_not_represen.final_status: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED (holds on Alibaba random split; does NOT hold under Alibaba temporal shift -- representation sensitivity is real and substantial there); INCONCLUSIVE (AIOps); NOT EVALUABLE (AgentRx)
H2_mechanism_is_supervision_not_represen.key_limitation: Only 3 pre-registered representations tested; PCA tested only at n_components=2.

H3_concept_drift_generalization.original_phase3_finding: Candidate F generalized across synthetic concept-only drift (fixed covariates, drift_scale varied), AUROC 0.602-0.698 across conditions.

alibaba_temporal_shift_characterization.conclusion: Q1-Q3 to Q4 is a COMPOUND shift (label rate + covariates), not a concept-only shift like the original.

H3_concept_drift_generalization.evidence_type: descriptive characterization, not a hypothesis test in the original sense
H3_concept_drift_generalization.final_status: NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE -- different shift type (concept-only vs. compound concept+covariate); AIOps/AgentRx not evaluable for this specific axis
H3_concept_drift_generalization.key_limitation: Exactly one real train/test temporal partition exists; no repeated-shift design possible on real data as it was on synthetic data via drift_scale.

H4_covariate_shift_attack_generalization.original_phase3_finding: Candidate F remained competitive with (not superior to) calibrated confidence under synthetic feature-noise/dropout attacks; GENERALIZATION SUPPORTED, narrow scope.

real_data_evidence.literal_mechanism: NOT EVALUABLE -- no real-data analogue of synthetic feature corruption exists; fabricating one is prohibited

evidence_type.alibaba: CONFIRMATORY_CAPABLE for the paired test itself, though effect sizes are small

H4_covariate_shift_attack_generalization.final_status: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED (R0/R1 retain a small but statistically real margin over no-signal on both datasets' unseen-category test; R2 does not) -- NOT DIRECTLY COMPARABLE to the original's synthetic-attack mechanism specifically; AgentRx NOT EVALUABLE
H4_covariate_shift_attack_generalization.key_limitation: Single held-out category per dataset (T4, db); not a sweep over possible unseen conditions.

H5a_complementarity.original_phase3_finding: F alone 0.6548, B alone 0.6599, combined BF 0.6593 -- F adds no measurable incremental value beyond calibrated confidence.
H5a_complementarity.real_data_evidence: NOT RUN -- no calibrated-confidence baseline exists in the real-data track, so there is nothing to test complementarity against. Not attempted in any Phase 3.1-RD-3.5-RD phase.
H5a_complementarity.key_limitation: Structural: the real-data track has never had a second independent risk signal to combine with a representation-based candidate.

H5b_decision_cost_policy.original_phase3_finding: At base cost ratio, all risk-based policies cost less than doing nothing; at a stricter ratio, every risk policy cost MORE than doing nothing.
H5b_decision_cost_policy.real_data_evidence: NOT RUN -- would require a disclosed, real deployment-relevant cost model for Alibaba/AIOps/AgentRx, which does not exist and was not fabricated in any Phase 3.1-RD-3.5-RD phase.
H5b_decision_cost_policy.key_limitation: No real cost model was in scope for any authorized real-data phase.

H6_diagnosis.original_phase3_finding: Deterministic diagnosis rule achieved pooled accuracy 0.683, macro F1 0.712 on synthetic attack-condition labels.
H6_diagnosis.real_data_evidence: NOT RUN in any Phase 3.1-RD-3.5-RD phase. AIOps fault categories exist (injected, not organic) and AgentRx has organic root_cause_failure_id/root_cause_reason fields identified as the strongest candidate diagnosis dataset in the original protocol design (docs/PHASE3_REAL_DATA_PROTOCOL.md section 3) -- but no diagnosis experiment was authorized or executed in Phase 3.1-RD through 3.5-RD.
H6_diagnosis.evidence_type: NOT EVALUABLE (not attempted, not due to a structural data blocker)
H6_diagnosis.final_status: NOT EVALUABLE -- awaiting a future authorized phase
H6_diagnosis.key_limitation: Not a data-availability gap like H5a/H7 -- AgentRx's root-cause fields exist and were preserved for exactly this purpose, but this authorization's scope (protocol design + 3.1-RD-3.6-RD synthesis) never included running it.

H7_recovery.original_phase3_finding: Zero feature_dropout CRITICAL-tier samples ever recovered by reconfiguration; INCONCLUSIVE, autonomous decision authority not justified.
H7_recovery.real_data_evidence: No dataset (Alibaba, AIOps, AgentRx) records a recovery action or outcome field.
H7_recovery.key_limitation: This is a data-acquisition gap, not an execution gap -- no future phase can evaluate H7 under the currently held datasets without new data.

cross_cutting_negative_findings: R2 (PCA(2)) AUROC collapses to 0.395 (below no-signal) on the Alibaba temporal split, a statistically significant HARM (paired diff -0.105, CI [-0.129,-0.082]) -- Phase 3.2-RD/3.4-RD.
R2 shows no statistically distinguishable improvement over no-signal under either unseen-workload-category test (Alibaba T4, AIOps db) -- Phase 3.5-RD.
The failure-risk signal's magnitude drops substantially under genuine unseen-workload-category generalization (Alibaba AUROC 0.57 vs 0.72-0.84 in-distribution) -- Phase 3.5-RD.
No calibrated-confidence-equivalent baseline exists anywhere in the real-data track -- structural, present since Phase 3.1-RD.
AgentRx's binary failure-risk task is not executable on either frozen sample -- structural, present since Phase 3.1-RD.
structural_gaps: AgentRx binary risk task (H1-H4 on AgentRx)
not_attempted_but_potentially_evaluable: H6 (diagnosis) -- AgentRx root-cause fields and AIOps injected-fault categories exist but were never used in an authorized phase
